behavior: All numeric inputs use IEEE-754 bit encodings; string values and nested records are length framed and tagged. Existing kernel-basis, decode-budget, prior, response-preparation and matrix encoders are reused. Both profile source routes, typed dataset metadata/events, space and sampling axes, selection order, actual basis samples/coefficient jets, nuisance, fit config, whitening, amplitude/criterion, decoder/execution policy, admission and ML evidence declarations participate in the canonical format.

Dataset space uses a persistent declared template world. Literal inputs include 24.0, -0.0, 0.1, 1e-6, delimiter-bearing labels, optional typed metadata sources, ARMA coefficients, precomputed first-row scale and nuisance values.

Geometry distinguishes onsets/durations/blocks, event weights/condition labels, expanded matrix values, frame/precision, whitening/nuisance presence and values. Additional checks distinguish IEEE signed zero, number vs integer metadata, source presence, LSS numeric config and whitening scope/initial policy.

limits: Identical numeric bits yield identical encodings. Numerically different basis/decomposition or computed coefficient values intentionally remain different identities; this format does not promise equality across different numerical implementations.
Matrix identities reuse the delivered 64-bit FNV-1a content digest and are not security hashes or collision-free cryptographic proofs.

Persistent physical frame/grid IDs, unit, coordinate convention, shape, affine and nonspatial sampling records are encoded. For an ephemeral frame/grid, absent persistent IDs cannot distinguish separate runtime owners with identical geometry; ephemeral ownership is not repaired here.

ParametricHrfFamily remains unsealed and kernel-basis/v2 still identifies it by name/chart/horizon: custom evaluators reusing those fields can collide. This remains a separate structural-family identity decision.
The unreachable ConditionProfile trial-axis count-only encoding remains a distinct caveat; this work does not change that producer.
